n = int(input())
s = list(input().strip())
tokens = input().strip().split()
beauty = list(map(int, tokens))
totalBeauty = sum(beauty)

t = 0
countChars = [0] * 26
minSum = 0
n_half = n // 2

for i in range(n_half):
    if s[i] == s[n - i - 1]:
        t += 1
        countChars[ord(s[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
        minSum += min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1])

maxCount = 0
maxCharIndex = 0
for i in range(26):
    if countChars[i] > maxCount:
        maxCount = countChars[i]
        maxCharIndex = i

if 2 * maxCount <= t:
    print(totalBeauty)
else:
    removable = []
    for i in range(n_half):
        if (ord(s[i]) - ord('a')) != maxCharIndex and (ord(s[n - i - 1]) - ord('a')) != maxCharIndex and s[i] != s[n - i - 1]:
            removable.append(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1]))
    removable.sort()
    toRemove = 2 * maxCount - t
    for i in range(toRemove):
        totalBeauty -= removable[i]
    print(totalBeauty)
